# The sync-option description changes to one address-book count

The new books-data message is one pluralized available-address-books description. Its caller passes total books minus already existing books and no accounts argument. The retained tests check 0/0/1 numeric arguments and disabled/enabled states; removed account-count checks are not rendered-translation coverage. The new sentence is distinct from copied recipe entries and has no COPY_PATTERN transform. No locale or sync run occurred.

Scope: Account Hub address-book sync text.
